# Wazoo — Verifiable Context Engine for AI

> Wazoo is the open-source verifiable context engine designed to manage, query, and prove interoperable knowledge bases at the edge. Instead of relying on fuzzy text blobs or uninspectable vector-only memory, Wazoo provides agents with a deterministic context graph that offers complete explainability and source provenance.

## Core Surfaces

- **Platform API (`https://api.wazoo.dev/v1`)**: Management plane for users, Worlds, platform tokens (`wzp_`), world tokens (`wzw_`), resource usage, and billing.
- **Wazoo TypeScript SDK (`@wazoo/client`)**: Primary TypeScript/Node.js client for platform resource management.
- **Worlds Data Engine (`@worlds/client`)**: Graph operations layer for RDF triples, SPARQL queries, vector search, import, and export.
- **Wazoo Console (`https://console.wazoo.dev`)**: Visual web control plane for inspecting graphs, managing keys, and reviewing billing.

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.wazoo.dev/quickstart): Get started with cURL, API keys (`wzp_`), and the `@wazoo/client` SDK in 2 minutes.
- [Wazoo Platform API](https://docs.wazoo.dev/platform/api): HTTP endpoints, authentication headers, error envelopes, and usage limits.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.wazoo.dev/platform/typescript-sdk): Install and use `@wazoo/client` to create and manage Worlds.

## Standalone Ecosystem Projects

Wazoo maintains an ecosystem of independent open-source projects built on shared semantic standards:

- [Worlds Engine](https://docs.wazoo.dev/projects/worlds): Persistent, edge-native knowledge graphs for agents.
- [Wiki CLI & Toolchain](https://docs.wazoo.dev/projects/wiki): Markdown wiki validator, SHACL linter, and static site generator.
- [Linked Markdown Spec](https://docs.wazoo.dev/projects/linked-markdown): Format specification for turning Markdown frontmatter into RDF graph nodes.
- [MemSDK](https://docs.wazoo.dev/projects/memsdk): Backend-agnostic memory interface contract for AI agents across Letta, Supermemory, and Worlds.

## Integration Guides & Agent Skills

- [Vercel AI SDK Integration](https://docs.wazoo.dev/integrations/ai-sdk): Connect AI SDK tool calls directly to Wazoo Worlds.
- [Claude Code Integration](https://docs.wazoo.dev/integrations/claude-code): Provide persistent memory across terminal pair-programming sessions.
- [Mastra Integration](https://docs.wazoo.dev/integrations/mastra): Use Wazoo graph memory inside Mastra workflows.
- [OpenCode Integration](https://docs.wazoo.dev/integrations/opencode): Configure local OpenCode workspace agents with Wazoo memory tools.
